semiconductor_relevance: High — Wonik Holdings specializes in gas supply systems and purifiers critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wonik Holdings Co., Ltd. is a leader in the gas equipment industry, providing essential gas supply systems and purification solutions for semiconductor and display markets. With a strong focus on safety and innovation, they support customers in managing hazardous gases effectively.
capabilities: Special gas purifiers and chambers (glove boxes)

regional_presence.Korea: Wonik Holdings holds a 45% market share of gas supply systems and 90% of gas purifiers in the OLED market in Korea.
regional_presence.China: The company has expanded its presence in the semiconductor and display markets in China.
regional_presence.East Asia: Wonik Holdings has a strategic focus on the East Asian semiconductor market.
